Le canon tire un laser. Chaque miroir le: The cannon fires a laser. Each mirror bounces it at a right angle; a click turns it. Light every crystal at once to finish the level. Walls stop the laser, crystals let it through. Three stars for few moves; a hint fixes one mirror, but the level is then worth one star.
Miroirs, un casse-tête en pixel art : to: Mirrors, a pixel-art puzzle: turn the mirrors to guide the laser to every crystal. 80 levels built from the laser's path, so always solvable, with walls and decoy mirrors; from level 41, colour filters, coloured crystals and a prism that splits the laser in two. A bright laser with sparks on the mirrors. Stars for levels done in few moves, hints if you get stuck. Mouse, keyboard or gamepad, full screen.
